COMPLETENESS CHECKS: (1) Public housing rent — checked against the full HUD eGIS PHA roster (all ~3,000 PHAs with public-housing units; roster tier, mostly without websites). (2) HUD-assisted private/nonprofit senior & family housing — checked against HUD 'Multifamily Properties - Assisted' (23,783 properties); every management agent with >=500 units in elderly properties or >=1,500 total units is included (~377 agents plus National Church Residences, Mercy Housing, WinnCompanies, RHF, VOA entered by hand); smaller agents (~4,700 with fewer units) are NOT listed — residents of those properties pay the on-site office. (3) HOA/condo: all firms named in scope (FirstService, Associa, AAM, Cardinal, CCMC, Sentry, Towne, RealManage, Leland) plus ~70 regional managers covering AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, IL, MA, MN, NC, NV, NJ, NY, SC, TX, UT, VA/MD, OH/KY; payment platforms (ClickPay, AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi CondoCafe/RentCafe, CINC WebAxis, Vantaca, Enumerate/TOPS, FRONTSTEPS, TownSq, CiraNet, PayHOA, Zego) and HOA bank lockboxes (Western Alliance/Alliance Association Bank, First Citizens PropertyPay ex-CIT/Mutual of Omaha, SmartStreet/Banc of California, Pacific Premier->Columbia, Truist Association Services). No authoritative national HOA-manager roster exists (CAI membership directory is not public), so the thousands of small local managers are not enumerated; most use one of the listed platforms/banks, which the app can route to by the payee printed on the coupon. (4) Senior living: all operators in scope (Brookdale, Sunrise, Atria, Holiday, Erickson, LCS, Five Star/AlerisLife, Discovery, Senior Lifestyle, Watermark, Benchmark) plus ~60 other operators/CCRC nonprofits (checked against memory of ASHA/Argentum top-operator lists — no downloadable list was reachable this session). (5) Manufactured-home lot rent: ELS, Sun, YES!, RHP, Hometown America, Havenpark, Cal-Am, Inspire, Continental, MHCommunities, Uniprop, Murex. (6) Timeshare maintenance fees: Wyndham, Marriott Vacation Clubs, Hilton Grand Vacations. PHA ROSTER BACKFILL 2026-09-30 (change log: categories/roster-backfill-housing-authorities.json): of 2993 HUD-coded PHA rent rows, 1169 now have an official website (was 49), 330 have a rent pay link, 72 are detailed (was 42). Sites were discovered by script from each PHA's HUD-listed email domain (HA_EMAIL_ADDR_TEXT, free-mail/ISP domains skipped) and ~80,000 domain-pattern candidates (city/name/acronym + ha/housing/hra/pha/mha etc.), DNS-resolved and fetched; a site was accepted only if the page showed the PHA's HUD phone number, or (for guessed domains) the title named the PHA AND the page matched its ZIP/street/state, or (for HUD email domains) the title/text named the PHA's city. 38 email-domain sites behind bot protection were kept as unverified; ~70 more were accepted by hand review (city/county government sites for government-run PHAs, and sister PHAs that administer small PHAs). pay_bill was set only when the homepage linked a rent-payment page or tenant portal (RentCafe/securecafe, PHA-Web, RentPayment, Zego/PayLease, HousingManager, Stratus, Tenmast, cpteller, BillerIQ, BillerPayments). Large HUD-assisted management agents (3,000+ units): 73 of 80 now have websites (from HUD MGMT_CONTACT_EMAIL_TEXT domains, fetched). Remaining 1824 PHAs without a website are mostly small rural PHAs that list a free-mail/ISP email with HUD. Also cleared pay_bill on Youngstown and Waukegan, whose pay pages say 'coming soon'. Denver, Milwaukee, Atlanta, Birmingham, Rochester, Augusta, Mobile, Tulsa, Austin, El Paso and Hialeah publish no public rent-payment page, or block automated reading; they keep phone numbers and websites at roster tier. Autopay cancellation is almost never published by PHAs.

entries.name: Cassia (nursing home chain)
entries.service_area_detail: 16 Medicare/Medicaid-certified nursing homes (1315 certified beds, ~1189 residents/day) per CMS Care Compare Aug 2026; states: MN, IA, ND, CO
entries.senior_programs: Nursing homes bill Medicare Part A (short-stay SNF days 1-100 with coinsurance from day 21), Medicaid (resident pays a monthly 'patient liability'/'share of cost' set by the state Medicaid agency), long-term-care insurance, or private pay. Ask the facility business office for the patient-liability letter and LTC-insurance assignment.
entries.notes: CMS chain name 'CASSIA' (Chain ID 120; top ownership type: Non profit - Corporation). CMS chain names are sometimes an owner's or management company's name rather than a consumer brand. Residents and families are billed by each facility's business office (name/phone on Medicare Care Compare: https://www.medicare.gov/care-compare/). Website not researched. [Link backfill 2026-09-30] Website https://www.cassialife.org/ confirmed by fetch 2026-09-30: page title "Cassia Senior Community Services"; evidence: title match (fac 0/16 city 0/15) (CMS facility names/cities from the Aug 2026 Provider Information file found on the site, or exact brand title match). Residents/families are still billed by each facility's business office unless a payment page is listed here. Cassia homepage 'Resident Pay Online' link opens a DonorPerfect WebLink payment form (Cassia = Elim Care + Augustana Care, MN/IA/ND/CO). Nursing-home bills: Medicare Part A covers skilled days 1-20 in full and days 21-100 with a daily coinsurance; Medicaid residents owe only the monthly patient-liability (share of cost) amount set by the state Medicaid agency; private-pay and LTC-insurance residents pay the full daily rate. Ask the business office for help with the Medicaid application/spend-down.

entries.name: Good Samaritan Society (Sanford Health)
entries.parent_company: Sanford Health (The Evangelical Lutheran Good Samaritan Society)
entries.service_area_detail: ~92 CMS-certified nursing homes plus senior living, rehab and home care, concentrated in the Upper Midwest and Plains
entries.phone_customer_service: 877-447-7237 (Center for Solutions / Patient Accounts; option 1 then option 2; M-Th 8-5, F 8-4:30)
entries.payment_processor: PointClickCare (PCC) statement / online payment for rehab-skilled and senior living; separate pages for Netsmart/Allscripts, Homecare Homebase, Continulink and KanTime home-care statements

entries.notes: 'Identify your bill type' page (https://www.good-sam.com/pay-bill) shows sample statements; Rehab/Skilled and Senior Living residents pay at /pay-bill/pcc with account number + resident date of birth. Recurring 'Direct Payment' (ACH) enrollment: complete the Direct Payment Authorization Form (docx) with a voided check and return it to the local location; brochure PDF https://www.good-sam.com/-/media/project/good-sam/pay-my-bill/pcc-directpayment.pdf. Cancellation per the form FAQ: signed written request to your location 30 days before discontinuation (or ask your bank to stop the transfer). Monthly statements are mailed by the location. [Review 2 2026-09-30] Direct Payment Authorization Form (docx) re-fetched: the authorization can be revoked with a signed written request to your location 30 days before discontinuation, and you can ask your bank to stop a transfer. Hence the same docx is used for autopay_cancel.
